minors.description: lua_test.zig contains minimal test implementation (2 tests: capability_set_init_and_deinit, string_contains_bytecode_magic). Test specification LUA-01-05.md defines 50+ comprehensive test cases covering bytecode rejection, stdlib restrictions, state isolation, host API registration, and capability enforcement. Current implementation is incomplete relative to spec scope, but all implemented tests pass.

test_run_output: zig build test-lua executed successfully. All unit tests pass. The lua_test.zig test binary includes 2 test functions: test_capability_set_init_and_deinit and test_string_contains_bytecode_magic. Both tests completed successfully with no errors.
coverage_notes: The test specification LUA-01-05.md defines 50+ test cases across 5 requirement areas: LUA-01 (binary dependency verification), LUA-02 (state isolation), LUA-03 (stdlib restrictions), LUA-04 (bytecode rejection), LUA-05 (host API and capability enforcement). Current test implementation in lua_test.zig covers only basic bytecode magic detection and capability set operations. Full coverage requires implementation of: (1) state isolation tests (sequential and concurrent), (2) stdlib module availability tests (math, string, table), (3) stdlib restriction tests (io, os, package, debug forbidden), (4) removed function tests (dump, load, loadstring, loadfile, dofile), (5) host API registration tests, (6) capability enforcement tests, (7) edge case tests. All currently implemented tests pass without error.
summary: Unit tests for Lua integration executed successfully. All 2 implemented test cases pass. Build completed without errors. Note: Test specification defines 50+ test cases; current implementation covers foundational bytecode detection and capability set initialization. Full requirement coverage pending additional test case implementation.
